international.title: Next issues cyber-attack warning after ‘benign’ data accessed by hackers
international.summary: Retailer says it believes no personal data that could lead to fraud was accessed after hack of third-party supplier Business live – latest updates Next has warned that hackers have gained access to data relating to the clothing and homewares retailer through a technology supplier. The firm said on Monday that it had been informed that one of its third-party suppliers had “experienced a cyber incident” resulting in unauthorised access to the data. Continue reading...
